objective: Exercise the guarded documentation-only pull request path
nonGoals: Change workflow, policy, dependency, or quality configuration
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN the approved documentation task is applied THEN one approved status sentence is added to the orchestration plan
WHEN the repository policy job runs THEN repository policy CI passes at the current SHA
WHEN local review sessions finish THEN fresh code/security and QA evidence references the current head SHA
WHEN required review sessions finish THEN both review roles use sessions distinct from implementation and each other
